swayable.summary: The video explains how a Trump executive order tried to take control of election rules in ways the president has no legal authority to do, and notes that courts have blocked part of it. It delivers this through a spoken back-and-forth conversation that lays out the facts and names the Brennan Center's lawsuit as a win.
swayable.title: How Trump's Executive Order Tried to Take Over Elections
